from httpie.cli.definition import parser
from httpie.plugins import plugin_manager
from httpie.plugins.builtin import BasicAuthPlugin, DigestAuthPlugin

    plugin_manager.register(DigestAuthPlugin)
    yield
    plugin_manager.unregister(BasicAuthPlugin)
    plugin_manager.unregister(DigestAuthPlugin)


def test__AuthTypeLazyChoices___contains__():

- `choices` is the same `_AuthTypeLazyChoices` instance, pulled from the parser so the test exercises the real argument rather than constructing a fresh one.

        assert isinstance(choices, _AuthTypeLazyChoices)
